public_rationale: Microsoft publicly reported nearly a gigawatt of additions in one quarter, so a literal claim that no evidence existed would be too strong. Zitron expressly acknowledges that disclosure, however, and questions whether it represents operating capacity. The retrieved records do not reconcile that metric with dated commissioning records. They also do not establish that only a few hundred megawatts came online. Neither substantive conclusion is settled.
limitations: This assessment does not verify the author's personal search experience.
A missing reconciliation is not evidence that Microsoft's disclosure was false.
Post-publication estimates cannot establish the public evidence available when this was written.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Zitron says he can find no evidence of more than a few hundred megawatts of Microsoft's data center capacity coming online.

statement.excerpt: As I’ll discuss below, I can find no evidence of anything more than a few hundred megawatts of Microsoft’s data center capacity coming online.
statement.document_title: Where Are All The Data Centers?

from_speaker: anything more than a few hundred megawatts
our_interpretation: I assess the substantive public-record assertion, not what the author personally found during his search.
In context, he is asking for evidence that capacity actually became operational beyond the aggregate company statements he expressly acknowledges.
The surrounding two-year comparison sets the target period to May 12, 2024 through May 12, 2026. The more recent quarterly claims are subsets of that period.
Owned facilities and leased capacity attributable to Microsoft count. A provider's entire capacity cannot be assigned to Microsoft from its revenue share.
A few hundred megawatts has no exact cutoff. Contradiction requires evidence comfortably above an ordinary reading of that phrase.
Evidence of public availability must itself predate or coincide with publication, because this claim concerns the evidence available then.
criteria.support_condition: A sufficiently complete review of contemporaneous public records establishes only a few hundred megawatts of identifiable Microsoft capacity newly commissioned during the stated period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Public records available by May 12, 2026 establish materially more than a few hundred megawatts of newly operating Microsoft capacity on a consistent basis without double-counting.
